content:
maria-ml: Quick intake — new candidate 'sable-60b' landed from eval queue. Asking for prioritization for bring-up + quant experiments. TL;DR: good RLHF samples, weird tokenization edge with emojis, baseline perf slightly worse on LongFormQA but 2x cheaper in cost profile.

kai: thanks — can you drop the eval artifacts link? also what's the expected traffic/use-case?

maria-ml: link: https://internal.storage/sable-60b/evals/v1 (redwood-auth)
use-cases: small-search reranking, assistant lite mode, embeddings for short-docs. Traffic: likely dev-facing first, then gradual ramp.

devon: quick read — model size/kv/cache looks compatible with our 1x8 A100 pool, quantization profile unknown. Recommend P0 for quant bench if we think cost wins offset potential LFQA dip.

maria-ml: agreed. proposing scope: 1) run quantization sweep (fp16, int8-gptq, int4-if-possible) 2) run longformqa + duty-cycle latency SLO tests 3) run embedding similarity parity vs baseline.

sasha: can we fold in prompt perturbation evals? last time we saw emoji/token dropouts under certain tokenizers.

maria-ml: yes — add prompt-mutation set from /evals/prompt-robustness/emoji-set. will attach.

kai: scoring suggestion for prioritization:
```
- product-fit: 3 (dev-facing, low initial revenue)
- cost-impact: 8 (potential 50% token-cost reduction vs baseline)
- operational-risk: 4 (unknown quant fragility)
- user-impact: 5 (quality drop on LFQA but ok elsewhere)
- total: 20/35
```

devon: +1 on cost-impact, but bump operational-risk to 6 until we see quant results. also add a soil-test: run a 10k-token streaming case to ensure KV cache health under continuous decode.

maria-ml: updated score: total 18/35 (with devon risk bump). Suggested next steps: 1) infra ticket to reserve 1x8 A100 window (eta: tomorrow) 2) quant sweep job (est 48h) 3) embed parity run (24h) 4) short canary on staging (if all green)

kai: I'll open infra ticket and assign to @ops-bot to schedule. pls include budget code.

ops-bot: Infra ticket created: INFRA-4521. Reserved window: 1768070000-1768083600 UTC (1x8 A100). Assigned: eng-ml-quant. Budget: RDW-Q2-ML-13.

maria-ml: thanks! will kick off quant sweep after ticket handoff. tagging @sasha to own prompt robustness runs.

sasha: taking it. I'll post quick results summary in this thread when I have first pass (24-36h). :particle_wave: 

devon: note for the runbook — if int8 degrades LFQA > 6% EM, try per-layer fallback (keep first 2 layers fp16) or look at llama-attn kernel flags.

kai: roadmap alignment — Q2 resource squeeze, so we should gate full bring-up on quant >= 0.85 embedding parity AND LFQA within 5% of baseline, otherwise deprioritize to P2. ok with that?

maria-ml: that's a sensible gate. I'll track in the onboarding checklist and link results.

sasha: first prompt robustness snapshot uploaded: https://internal.storage/sable-60b/robustness/initial.json (short summary: emoji token breakup observed in ~3% prompts, mostly short-form; will try tokenizer workaround)

maria-ml: awesome. leaving this thread open for updates. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
